entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Qiu Ying was a renowned Chinese painter of the Ming dynasty who specialised in the gongbi brush technique.

As a key figure associated with the development of Chinese art during the 16th century, Qiu Ying's works have had a lasting impact on the cultural heritage of China.

His masterful use of gongbi brushes and traditional Chinese motifs has influenced generations of artists, from the Qing dynasty to contemporary Chinese artists.

Qiu Ying's legacy extends beyond the realm of art, as his works also reflect the cultural and social changes taking place in China during this period.
